families.label: Hybrid
families.long: Hybrid: AI team within the rules

family_text.rule: Rules read the data, use a standard strategy or invent a new one, and predict the price. No AI is involved. Stocks: for example “Model + news”. F&O: Book 1.
family_text.hybrid: The AI team does the analysis and research, but acts only inside the rule-based limits. Stocks: planned, no hybrid stock strategy yet. F&O: Book 2.
family_text.ai: A team of AI agents with different roles decides on its own: it uses an existing strategy or invents a new one. F&O: Book 3.
family_text.baseline: Simple yardsticks a strategy has to beat (“Always buy”, “Follow yesterday”, “Model without news”); never in the head-to-head.
